name: unified_log
description: Read a unified log archive with Apple's log command or Mandiant's unifiedlog_iterator. On Linux, keeps every decoded entry as JSONL and names the complete output and any parser warnings.

path.description: A .logarchive, or a directory holding diagnostics and uuidtext

predicate.description: Apple log only: an NSPredicate, e.g. 'process == "sudo"'

start.description: Apple log only: start time, e.g. '2026-02-14 00:00:00'

out_dir.description: Where the reader's own output is kept, under work/

limit.description: Apple log only: maximum inline entries (default 500); complete stdout is also kept under out_dir
